# JLITE Engineers

> Premier Government A-Grade licensed electrical contractor up to 33kV, electrical engineering consultancy, and Light Pitcher commercial LED lighting manufacturer in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Home Page](https://www.jliteengineers.com/): Official overview of JLITE Engineers, Govt A-Grade 33kV licensing, product lines, and electrical services.
- [Electrical Contractors in Chennai](https://www.jliteengineers.com/electrical-contractors-chennai/): Turnkey HT/LT substation installations up to 33kV, transformer erections, main LT switchgear, cable laying, and industrial plant electrification.
- [Electrical Consultant in Chennai](https://www.jliteengineers.com/electrical-consultant-chennai/): Single-Line Diagram (SLD) preparation, load demand calculations, CEIG statutory liaison approvals, power quality audits, and engineering project management.
- [Light Fixtures Suppliers in Chennai](https://www.jliteengineers.com/light-fixtures-suppliers-chennai/): Commercial, architectural, and industrial lighting catalog, Light Pitcher 2x2 modular office troffers, suspended linear profiles, LED panels, and high bays.
- [Service Locations & India-Wide Supply](https://www.jliteengineers.com/#service-locations): Industrial contracting hubs in Chennai and pan-India electrical product & luminaire supply.
- [Product Catalog](https://www.jliteengineers.com/#products): ISI/CE certified MCBs, RCCBs, distribution boards, smart touch switches, and armoured industrial power cables.
